title: 实验 3-2 · RC 微分电路与积分电路
summary: 同一个方波同时喂给两条 RC 支路：取电阻电压得到尖脉冲（微分），取电容电压得到三角波（积分）。
concepts: 基波相位 phase of the fundamental
description: **目标**：用同一个方波驱动两条 RC 支路，看 τ ≪ T/2 时电阻电压像“微分”，τ ≫ T/2 时电容电压像“积分”。
**电路**（两条支路都接在信号发生器输出 VIN 和 GND 之间）：
- 微分支路：VIN → C1（10 nF）→ 结点 VD → R1（10 kΩ）→ GND，输出取**电阻**上的电压 VD；
- 积分支路：VIN → R2（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VI → C2（1 µF）→ GND，输出取**电容**上的电压 VI。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 2.5 V、偏置 0（在 −2.5 V 和 +2.5 V 之间跳，每次跳 5 V），频率 500 Hz（半周期 T/2 = 1 ms）。
**示波器**：CH1 看 VD（R1 上端），CH2 看 VI（C2 上端），地夹接 GND。想看输入时把一个探头挪到 VIN。
**先预测**：先算两条支路的 τd = R1·C1 和 τi = R2·C2，和半周期 1 ms 比一比。微分支路：电容电压不能突变，方波跳 5 V 的瞬间 VD 跳到多少？之后多快回到 0？积分支路：半个周期里电容只走了指数曲线的哪一段？VI 是什么形状、Vpp 大约多少？
**测量**：在 500 Hz 下读 VD 的尖峰和平均值、VI 的波形和 Vpp；再把频率调到 50 Hz 看 VI 怎么变。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**想一想（用相位验证）**：把方波看成它的基波（500 Hz 正弦）。积分电路的电容电压落后输入 arctan(ωτi)；微分电路的电阻电压超前输入 arctan(1/(ωτd))。记住：RC 电路叫不叫积分 / 微分电路，看的是 τ 和信号周期的比值。

en.title: Experiment 3-2 · RC differentiator and integrator
en.summary: One square wave feeds two RC branches: across the resistor you get spikes (differentiator), across the capacitor a triangle (integrator).
description: **Goal**: drive two RC branches with the same square wave and see that with τ ≪ T/2 the resistor voltage looks like a "derivative", and with τ ≫ T/2 the capacitor voltage looks like an "integral".
**Circuit** (both branches sit between the generator output VIN and GND):
- differentiator: VIN → C1 (10 nF) → node VD → R1 (10 kΩ) → GND; the output is the **resistor** voltage VD;
- integrator: VIN → R2 (10 kΩ) → node VI → C2 (1 µF) → GND; the output is the **capacitor** voltage VI.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 2.5 V, offset 0 (jumping between −2.5 V and +2.5 V, 5 V per jump), 500 Hz (half period T/2 = 1 ms).
**Scope**: CH1 on VD (top of R1), CH2 on VI (top of C2), ground clips on GND. To see the input, move one probe to VIN.

**Predict first**: work out τd = R1·C1 and τi = R2·C2 and compare them with the 1 ms half period. Differentiator: the capacitor voltage cannot jump, so where does VD go at the instant of a 5 V jump, and how fast does it return to 0? Integrator: which part of the exponential does the capacitor cover in half a period? What shape is VI and roughly what is its Vpp?

**Measure**: at 500 Hz read VD's spikes and average and VI's shape and Vpp; then turn the frequency down to 50 Hz and watch VI change. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**Think about it (check with phase)**: think of the square wave as its fundamental (a 500 Hz sine). The integrator's capacitor voltage lags the input by arctan(ωτi); the differentiator's resistor voltage leads the input by arctan(1/(ωτd)). Remember: whether an RC circuit acts as an integrator or a differentiator depends on τ compared with the signal's period.
compare: - **Differentiator (τd ≪ T/2)**: when the square wave jumps by 5 V, all 5 V first appear across the resistor: VD jumps to about ±5 V, then decays with τd and is back at 0 well within half a period. VD is a train of positive and negative spikes that appear only when the input *changes*: v_R = RC·dv_C/dt ≈ RC·dv_in/dt (since v_C ≈ v_in). The simulated scope takes a sample every 7.8 µs while the spike loses 63% in 0.1 ms, so the peak it reads is a little below the ideal 5 V (about 4.6 V) — a real scope with too slow a sample rate does the same. The spikes are symmetric, so their average is ≈ 0 (the capacitor blocks DC).

- **Integrator (τi ≫ T/2)**: half a period is only 1/10 of τi, so the capacitor only travels the first, nearly straight, piece of the exponential and VI is a triangle: v_C = (1/RC)∫v_R dt ≈ (1/RC)∫v_in dt. Slope ≈ 2.5 V / 10 ms = 250 V/s, so it rises ≈ 0.25 V per half period: Vpp ≈ 0.25 V (exactly 5 V × tanh(T/(4τi)) = 5 × tanh(0.05) ≈ 0.25 V).
- **50 Hz (T/2 = 10 ms)**: τi is no longer much bigger than T/2, VI becomes an ordinary charge/discharge curve and its Vpp grows to 5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V — the integrator condition no longer holds.

measurements.ask: 500 Hz: the peak of the CH1 (VD, resistor voltage) spikes
measurements.explain: The capacitor voltage cannot jump, so the whole 5 V step lands on the resistor: ideally ≈ 5 V; the spike loses 63% in 0.1 ms and the scope samples miss the very top, so it reads about 4.6 V.

measurements.ask: 500 Hz: the Vpp of the CH2 (VI, capacitor voltage) triangle
measurements.explain: Slope ≈ 2.5 V / 10 ms = 250 V/s, so 1 ms of half period covers ≈ 0.25 V. Exactly: 5 × tanh(T/(4τi)) ≈ 0.25 V.

measurements.ask: Treat the triangle as straight lines: slope = 2.5 V / τi, and one 1 ms half period covers Vpp. From your Vpp, τi = 2.5 V × 1 ms / Vpp
measurements.explain: τi = R2·C2 = 10 kΩ × 1 µF = 10 ms (10.05 ms with the generator's 50 Ω). The integrator's output is small precisely because τi ≫ T/2.

measurements.ask: 500 Hz: the phase of VI relative to the generator output (positive = leading)
measurements.explain: For the fundamental: the capacitor voltage lags by arctan(ωτi) ≈ arctan(31) ≈ 88°, close to an ideal integrator's −90°.
A 10 ms half period ≈ τi, so τi ≫ T/2 no longer holds: 5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V, an ordinary charge/discharge curve.

hints: Differentiator: capacitor first (in series), resistor to GND, output across the resistor.
Integrator: resistor first (in series), capacitor to GND, output across the capacitor.
Both branches start at the generator's red clip; everything returns to the black clip (GND).
tests: 500 Hz: VD is a train of ± spikes, average ≈ 0, leading the input
500 Hz: VI is a small triangle lagging the input by nearly 90°
50 Hz: the integrator condition fails and VI grows

tests.name: 500 Hz：VD 是正负尖脉冲，平均 ≈ 0，超前输入
500 Hz：VI 是小三角波，落后输入接近 90°
50 Hz：积分条件不成立，VI 变大

compare: - **微分电路（τd ≪ T/2）**：方波一跳 5 V，这 5 V 全部先落在电阻上，VD 跳到约 ±5 V，然后以 τd 指数衰减，不到半个周期就回到 0。VD 是一串正负尖脉冲，只在输入“变化”的时刻出现：v_R = RC·dv_C/dt ≈ RC·dv_in/dt（因为 v_C ≈ v_in）。仿真示波器每 7.8 µs 取一个点，而尖脉冲 0.1 ms 就衰减掉 63%，所以屏幕上读到的峰值比理想的 5 V 略低（约 4.6 V）——真实示波器采样不够快时也是这样。尖脉冲正负对称，平均值 ≈ 0（电容隔直）。

- **积分电路（τi ≫ T/2）**：半个周期只有 τi 的 1/10，电容只走了指数曲线开头近乎直线的一段，于是 VI 是三角波：v_C = (1/RC)∫v_R dt ≈ (1/RC)∫v_in dt。斜率 ≈ 2.5 V / 10 ms = 250 V/s，半个周期上升 ≈ 0.25 V，所以 Vpp ≈ 0.25 V（精确值 5 V × tanh(T/(4τi)) = 5 × tanh(0.05) ≈ 0.25 V）。
- **50 Hz（T/2 = 10 ms）**：积分支路的 τi 不再远大于 T/2，VI 变成普通的充放电曲线，Vpp 增大到 5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V——“积分”的条件不成立了。

measurements.ask: 500 Hz：CH1（VD，电阻电压）尖脉冲的峰值
measurements.explain: 电容电压不能突变，方波一跳 5 V 全落在电阻上，理想峰值 ≈ 5 V；尖峰 0.1 ms 衰减 63%，示波器采样点落不到最顶上，读到约 4.6 V。

measurements.ask: 500 Hz：CH2（VI，电容电压）三角波的 Vpp
measurements.explain: 斜率 ≈ 2.5 V / 10 ms = 250 V/s，半周期 1 ms 走 ≈ 0.25 V。精确值 5 × tanh(T/(4τi)) ≈ 0.25 V。

measurements.ask: 把三角波当直线：斜率 = 2.5 V / τi，半周期 1 ms 走完 Vpp。用你的 Vpp 算 τi = 2.5 V × 1 ms / Vpp
measurements.explain: τi = R2·C2 = 10 kΩ × 1 µF = 10 ms（加上信号发生器的 50 Ω 是 10.05 ms）。积分电路的输出很小，正是因为 τi ≫ T/2。

measurements.ask: 500 Hz：VI 相对信号发生器输出的相位（正 = 超前）
measurements.explain: 按基波算：电容电压落后 arctan(ωτi) ≈ arctan(31) ≈ 88°，接近理想积分的 −90°。
半周期 10 ms ≈ τi，不再满足 τi ≫ T/2：5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V，波形变成普通的充放电曲线。

hints: 微分：电容在前（串联），电阻接地，输出取电阻电压。
积分：电阻在前（串联），电容接地，输出取电容电压。
两条支路的起点都是信号发生器红夹子，终点都回到黑夹子（GND）。
